Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing conflicts of interest in certain construction contracts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing conflicts of interest in constructioncontracts; adding a new section to chapter 47.28 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person, firm, or corporation proposing a bid for theconstruction or improvement of any state highway or any other projectfor the department, in response to a call for bids, must disclose inthe bid proposal any circumstances where the person, firm, orcorporation or any affiliated person, firm, or corporation wouldpotentially benefit from any portion of any other contract with thedepartment that is reasonably related to the construction orimprovement of any state highway or any other project for thedepartment upon which the person, firm, or corporation is proposing abid. (2) Whenever any contract for the construction or improvement ofany state highway or any other project for the department is dependentupon work performed pursuant to another contract with the department, p. 1 HB 1801the department must ensure that the liquidated damages provisions ofthe related contracts prevent any person, firm, or corporation with afinancial interest in two or more contracts from receiving liquidateddamages under a contract or contracts that are more than the person,firm, or corporation is required to pay under another contract orcontracts in the event that payments are required under two or moreliquidated damages provisions in related contracts.
